summary: The fileglob filter returns files matching a glob pattern, evaluated on the controller's filesystem.
questions: How do I list files matching a pattern in Ansible?
Does fileglob search the remote host or the controller?

answer_card.title: fileglob filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ '/path/*.conf' | fileglob }}` returns a list of matching files. Filters run on the **controller**, so it matches files on the controller, not the managed host.
